The living area in the Jade Penthouse welcomes you with a grey sofa, blue cushions and two light-coloured armchairs at round wooden tables. The dining table and open-plan kitchen are together, while two separate bedrooms offer a place to retreat.

In the Jade penthouse, you can move directly from the wooden dining table to the grey sofa. Round coffee tables and a petrol-coloured built-in cupboard give the living area next to the glazed patio door a warm character.

The petrol-coloured kitchen in the Jade penthouse offers you a hob, oven, microwave and coffee machine for preparing your meals. A light strip highlights the dark worktop with sink and makes the area cosy.

Petrol-coloured cupboards and an illuminated wardrobe accompany you through the kitchen and hallway of the Jade Penthouse. Wooden parquet flooring connects the areas with the dining table and the glazed patio door at the end of the room.

In the Jade Penthouse, you can eat together at the wooden dining table, directly opposite the teal-coloured kitchen with oven and microwave. Four chairs and the glazed patio door give the open-plan dining area an inviting ambience.

The double bed in the Jade Penthouse, with its white bed linen and grey blanket, offers you a cosy place to stretch out. Black reading lamps, a wooden bedside table and pictures of plants complement the petrol-coloured back wall.

One of two separate bedrooms in the Jade Penthouse awaits you with a double bed, a grey blanket and an orange headboard. An en-suite bathroom and direct access to the roof terrace complete the room, which has a petrol-coloured back wall.

The shower in the Jade Penthouse features a fixed round overhead shower and an additional hand shower. White rectangular tiles give the area a bright look, and a glass pane forms the right-hand edge of the image.

In one of the two bathrooms in the Jade Penthouse, which are directly accessible from the bedroom, you can start your day at the wooden vanity unit. An illuminated mirror, white tiles and a shower give the room a welcoming feel.

In the Jade Penthouse's washroom, you will find a white basin on a dark countertop with a warm wooden vanity unit. An illuminated mirror, a make-up mirror and a wide shelf with a vase provide a welcoming setting for your morning routine.

If you need to jot down a few notes, you can take a seat at the narrow wooden table with a stool in the Jade Penthouse, with the TV hanging above it. On the left is the glazed patio door, and on the right is the doorway to the bedroom.

From the Jade Penthouse, you can let your gaze wander over the red roofs and green treetops of the neighbourhood. An old yellow building and a bright high-rise stand out against the blue sky and give the cityscape its character.

On one of the two roof terraces of the Jade penthouse, you can look out over red roofs from the grey corner sofa. Wooden floorboards and a low table make the space between the white railing and the side privacy screen cosy.

On the terrace of the Jade Penthouse, you can choose between a grey lounge area and a high table with stools. Two lanterns adorn the low table, while the wooden floorboards lend the outdoor area warm tones.

In the shared laundry room, there are three washing machines under three dryers, complemented by a white sink. Open black shelves and colourful containers add a splash of colour to this practical area for everyday life on the go.
The apartment building welcomes you with a bright façade, large windows and several rows of balconies. The tree, with its warm autumn foliage, adds a vibrant touch against the clean architecture.

The floor plan of the Jade penthouse combines an eat-in kitchen with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Terraces on opposite sides complement the rooms and clearly demonstrate the interplay between indoors and outdoors.
